atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日本关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段并进攻沈阳北大营，中国抗日战争由此开始。
summary.en: The Japanese Kwantung Army blew up the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu and attacked Beidaying in Shenyang, beginning China’s war of resistance.

fields.name: 九一八事变 Mukden Incident 沈阳事变 Shenyang Incident
fields.summary: 日本关东军炸毁南满铁路柳条湖段并进攻沈阳北大营，中国抗日战争由此开始。 The Japanese Kwantung Army blew up the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu and attacked Beidaying in Shenyang, beginning China’s war of resistance.
fields.description: 1931 年 9 月 18 日夜，日本关东军自行炸毁沈阳北郊柳条湖附近的南满铁路路轨，反诬中国军队所为，随即进攻东北军北大营和沈阳城。此后数月，日军侵占东北大部。 本事件日期与地点为通行说法，具体战斗经过待史料校订。 On the night of 18 September 1931, the Japanese Kwantung Army destroyed a section of the South Manchuria Railway near Liutiaohu, blamed Chinese troops, and attacked Beidaying and Shenyang. Within months Japanese forces occupied most of the Northeast. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts; details await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军进攻上海闸北，第十九路军等部奋起抵抗，淞沪地区爆发激烈战斗。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai; the 19th Route Army and other Chinese units resisted in fierce fighting.

fields.name: 一·二八事变 January 28 Incident 淞沪抗战 January 28 Resistance
fields.summary: 日军进攻上海闸北，第十九路军等部奋起抵抗，淞沪地区爆发激烈战斗。 Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai; the 19th Route Army and other Chinese units resisted in fierce fighting.
fields.description: 1932 年 1 月 28 日，日军以保护侨民为借口进攻上海闸北。第十九路军在蒋光鼐、蔡廷锴指挥下抵抗，双方在淞沪地区激战至 3 月。5 月，中日签订《淞沪停战协定》。 本事件日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On 28 January 1932, Japanese forces attacked Zhabei in Shanghai under the pretext of protecting residents. The 19th Route Army, commanded by Jiang Guangnai and Cai Tingkai, resisted until March. In May, China and Japan signed the Shanghai Ceasefire Agreement. Dates and locations follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 日军占领哈尔滨，东北主要城市至此基本沦陷。
summary.en: Japanese forces captured Harbin, completing the occupation of the Northeast’s major cities.

fields.name: 哈尔滨沦陷 Fall of Harbin
fields.place: 黑龙江哈尔滨 Harbin, Heilongjiang
fields.summary: 日军占领哈尔滨，东北主要城市至此基本沦陷。 Japanese forces captured Harbin, completing the occupation of the Northeast’s major cities.
fields.description: 1932 年 2 月 5 日，日军进入哈尔滨。此前齐齐哈尔、锦州等地已相继失守，东北三省主要城市至此基本被日军控制。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期取通行说法，待史料校订。 Japanese troops entered Harbin on 5 February 1932. Qiqihar, Jinzhou, and other cities had already fallen, leaving the major cities of the three northeastern provinces largely under Japanese control. This event marks a route segment endpoint; the date follows conventional accounts and awaits historical review.

place.en: Changchun, Jilin (called “Xinjing” by the puppet state)

summary.zh: 日本扶植溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，东北被纳入日本殖民统治体系。
summary.en: Japan installed Puyi as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, placing the Northeast under colonial rule.

fields.name: 伪满洲国成立 Establishment of Manchukuo
fields.place: 吉林长春（伪满称“新京”） Changchun, Jilin (called “Xinjing” by the puppet state)
fields.summary: 日本扶植溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，东北被纳入日本殖民统治体系。 Japan installed Puyi as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, placing the Northeast under colonial rule.
fields.description: 1932 年 3 月 1 日，日本扶植清朝末代皇帝溥仪在长春成立伪满洲国，随后以“日满议定书”等形式加以控制。中国政府与国际联盟均未承认该政权。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 1 March 1932, Japan installed Puyi, the last Qing emperor, as head of the puppet state of Manchukuo in Changchun, later controlling it through agreements such as the Japan-Manchukuo Protocol. Neither the Chinese government nor the League of Nations recognized the regime. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.en: Students in Beiping marched to demand resistance and national salvation, helping to galvanize anti-Japanese sentiment nationwide.

fields.name: 一二·九运动 December Ninth Movement
fields.summary: 北平学生举行抗日救亡请愿游行，推动全国抗日救亡运动高涨。 Students in Beiping marched to demand resistance and national salvation, helping to galvanize anti-Japanese sentiment nationwide.
fields.description: 1935 年 12 月 9 日，北平学生数千人举行抗日救亡请愿游行，反对华北自治，要求停止内战、一致对外。运动迅速扩展到全国，成为抗日民族统一战线形成的重要背景。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 9 December 1935, thousands of students in Beiping demonstrated against the autonomy movement in North China and called for an end to civil war and united resistance. The movement spread nationwide and became an important backdrop to the formation of the anti-Japanese united front. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 西安事变 Xi’an Incident
fields.summary: 张学良、杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，促成停止内战、联共抗日的转折。 Zhang Xueliang and Yang Hucheng detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, leading to a turn toward ending the civil war and resisting Japan.
fields.description: 1936 年 12 月 12 日，东北军将领张学良与第十七路军将领杨虎城在西安扣留蒋介石，要求停止内战、一致抗日。经多方斡旋，事变和平解决，为抗日民族统一战线的形成创造了条件。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 12 December 1936, Zhang Xueliang of the Northeast Army and Yang Hucheng of the 17th Route Army detained Chiang Kai-shek in Xi’an, demanding an end to the civil war and united resistance against Japan. The incident was resolved peacefully, helping pave the way for the anti-Japanese united front. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军在卢沟桥附近挑起冲突并进攻宛平城，中国全面抗战由此爆发。
summary.en: Japanese forces provoked a clash near the Marco Polo Bridge and attacked Wanping, marking the start of full-scale Chinese resistance.

fields.name: 卢沟桥事变 Marco Polo Bridge Incident 七七事变 July 7 Incident
fields.place: 北平卢沟桥 Marco Polo Bridge, Beiping
fields.summary: 日军在卢沟桥附近挑起冲突并进攻宛平城，中国全面抗战由此爆发。 Japanese forces provoked a clash near the Marco Polo Bridge and attacked Wanping, marking the start of full-scale Chinese resistance.
fields.description: 1937 年 7 月 7 日夜，日军在北平西南卢沟桥附近演习，借口士兵失踪要求进入宛平城搜查，遭拒后发动进攻。中国守军第二十九军奋起抵抗，战事迅速扩大。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On the night of 7 July 1937, Japanese troops on exercise near the Marco Polo Bridge demanded entry into Wanping to search for a missing soldier. After being refused, they attacked. The Chinese 29th Army resisted, and the fighting quickly escalated. This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

atlasTitle.en: The War of Resistance Against Japan

summary.zh: 中日双方在上海投入重兵鏖战三个月，中国军队粉碎了日军速战速决的企图。
summary.en: China and Japan poured troops into three months of fighting in Shanghai, thwarting Japan’s hope for a quick victory.

fields.name: 淞沪会战 Battle of Shanghai 八一三事变 August 13 Incident 淞沪抗战 Battle of Shanghai
fields.summary: 中日双方在上海投入重兵鏖战三个月，中国军队粉碎了日军速战速决的企图。 China and Japan poured troops into three months of fighting in Shanghai, thwarting Japan’s hope for a quick victory.
fields.description: 1937 年 8 月 13 日，淞沪会战爆发。中国军队先后投入数十万兵力，与日军在上海市区及周边反复争夺。11 月，中国军队西撤，上海沦陷，但会战打破了日军“三个月灭亡中国”的计划。 本事件为路线分段端点，日期与战果表述待史料校订。 The Battle of Shanghai began on 13 August 1937. Hundreds of thousands of Chinese troops fought Japanese forces in and around the city. In November the Chinese army withdrew west and Shanghai fell, but the battle shattered Japan’s plan to conquer China in three months. This event marks a route segment endpoint; dates and assessments await historical review.

summary.en: Chinese forces blocked the Japanese at Xinkou for nearly a month before the position fell and Taiyuan was lost.

fields.name: 忻口会战 Battle of Xinkou 忻口战役 Xinkou Campaign
fields.summary: 中国军队在忻口阻击日军，激战近一个月，忻口最终失守，太原随后沦陷。 Chinese forces blocked the Japanese at Xinkou for nearly a month before the position fell and Taiyuan was lost.
fields.description: 1937 年 10 月，日军第五师团等部沿同蒲铁路南下，进攻忻口。中国第二战区部队在卫立煌指挥下依托阵地顽强抵抗，双方在忻口一线激战。日军久攻不下，后因娘子关失守、中国军队侧后受威胁，中国军队于 11 月 2 日撤退，太原于 11 月 8 日失守。此役是太原会战的重要组成部分。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In October 1937, Japanese forces including the 5th Division advanced south along the Datong–Pukou railway and attacked Xinkou. Chinese troops of the Second War Zone, commanded by Wei Lihuang, resisted stubbornly from prepared positions in fierce fighting around Xinkou. Unable to break through quickly, the Japanese exploited the fall of Niangziguan and threatened the Chinese flank and rear; Chinese forces withdrew on 2 November, and Taiyuan fell on 8 November. The battle was an important part of the Taiyuan campaign. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 南京沦陷与南京大屠杀 Fall of Nanjing and the Nanjing Massacre 南京大屠杀 Nanjing Massacre 南京保卫战 Defense of Nanjing
fields.summary: 日军攻占南京后对平民和战俘实施大规模屠杀、强奸与劫掠，造成惨重伤亡。 After capturing Nanjing, Japanese forces carried out mass killings, rape, and looting against civilians and prisoners of war.
fields.description: 1937 年 12 月 13 日，日军攻占南京。随后数周内，日军在南京及周边地区对放下武器的中国军人和无辜平民实施大规模屠杀、强奸、纵火与抢劫。远东国际军事法庭认定伤亡规模巨大。 本事件为路线分段端点，具体伤亡数字存在不同统计口径，待史料校订。 Japanese forces captured Nanjing on 13 December 1937. In the following weeks they carried out mass killings, rape, arson, and looting against disarmed Chinese soldiers and civilians in and around the city. The International Military Tribunal for the Far East found the scale of the atrocities to be enormous. fields.name: 兰封会战 Battle of Lanfeng 兰封战役 Lanfeng Campaign
fields.place: 河南兰封（今兰考） Lanfeng (now Lankao), Henan
fields.summary: 中国军队围攻兰封日军第 14 师团，因日军增援与协同问题未能全歼，最终撤退。 Chinese forces besieged the Japanese 14th Division at Lanfeng; Japanese reinforcements and coordination problems prevented a full encirclement, and the Chinese withdrew.
fields.description: 1938 年 5 月，徐州会战后期，中国军队在兰封地区围攻日军第 14 师团。中国军队一度收复兰封，但日军增援逼近，中国军队侧背受威胁，被迫撤退。此役是徐州会战的重要组成部分，也暴露了指挥协同与装备差距。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1938, late in the Xuzhou campaign, Chinese forces besieged the Japanese 14th Division around Lanfeng. Chinese troops briefly recovered Lanfeng, but as Japanese reinforcements approached and threatened their flank and rear, they were forced to withdraw. The battle was an important part of the Xuzhou campaign and exposed gaps in command coordination and equipment. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.en: After the Battle of Wuhan, Japanese forces captured the city, and the war entered a phase of strategic stalemate.

fields.name: 武汉失守 Fall of Wuhan 武汉会战 Battle of Wuhan 武汉保卫战 Defense of Wuhan
fields.summary: 武汉会战后日军占领武汉，抗日战争进入战略相持阶段。 After the Battle of Wuhan, Japanese forces captured the city, and the war entered a phase of strategic stalemate.
fields.description: 1938 年 6 月起，日军沿长江南北进攻武汉。中国军队组织武汉会战，激战数月后于 10 月撤出。10 月 25 日武汉失守，国民政府机关此前已迁往重庆，抗日战争逐步进入战略相持阶段。 本事件为路线相关节点，日期与表述待史料校订。 From June 1938, Japanese forces advanced on Wuhan from both sides of the Yangtze. Chinese troops fought the Battle of Wuhan for months before withdrawing in October. Wuhan fell on 25 October; government organs had already moved to Chongqing, and the war gradually entered a phase of strategic stalemate. This event is linked to route segments; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.description: 1939 年 5 月，日军第 11 军向随县、枣阳地区进攻，企图打击中国第五战区主力。中国军队依托地形逐次抵抗，并在日军补给困难时反击，至 5 月下旬恢复原阵地。此役是抗战进入相持阶段后的重要作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1939, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Suixian and Zaoyang areas, seeking to strike the main forces of China’s Fifth War Zone. Chinese troops used the terrain to resist in stages and counterattacked as Japanese supply lines became strained, restoring the original line by late May. It was an important operation after the war entered the stalemate phase. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.place: 湖南新墙河一线 Xinqiang River line, Hunan
fields.summary: 日军进攻长沙，中国军队在新墙河、汨罗江一线阻击并反击，恢复原阵地。 Japanese forces attacked Changsha; Chinese troops blocked and counterattacked along the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, restoring their original positions.
fields.description: 1939 年 9 月 14 日，日军集中兵力向湖南新墙河一线发起进攻，企图攻取长沙。中国军队第九战区部队逐次阻击，诱敌深入后侧击、反击，迫使日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役是抗战进入相持阶段后中国正面战场的一次重要防御作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 On 14 September 1939, Japanese forces launched an offensive across the Xinqiang River in Hunan in an attempt to take Changsha. Chinese troops of the Ninth War Zone resisted in stages, drew the Japanese forward, then struck their flanks and counterattacked, forcing a withdrawal to the original line in early October. It was an important defensive battle on China’s frontal battlefield during the stalemate phase. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.zh: 中国军队反攻昆仑关，经过激战收复关隘，取得昆仑关大捷。
summary.en: Chinese forces counterattacked at Kunlun Pass and recaptured the strategic pass after fierce fighting.

fields.name: 昆仑关战役 Battle of Kunlun Pass 昆仑关大捷 Kunlun Pass Victory
fields.place: 广西南宁昆仑关 Kunlun Pass, Nanning, Guangxi
fields.summary: 中国军队反攻昆仑关，经过激战收复关隘，取得昆仑关大捷。 Chinese forces counterattacked at Kunlun Pass and recaptured the strategic pass after fierce fighting.
fields.description: 1939 年 12 月，中国军队为收复南宁、夺回昆仑关，对日军发起反攻。中国第 5 军等部在昆仑关与日军激战，反复争夺，最终于 1940 年 1 月收复昆仑关，击毙日军旅团长中村正雄。此役是抗战中期中国军队的一次重要攻坚胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In December 1939, Chinese forces launched a counteroffensive to recover Nanning and retake Kunlun Pass. The Chinese 5th Army and other units fought fierce, seesaw battles against the Japanese at the pass, finally recapturing it in January 1940 and killing the Japanese brigade commander Nakamura Masao. It was an important Chinese offensive victory in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 枣宜会战 Battle of Zaoyang–Yichang 枣宜战役 Zaoyi Campaign
fields.summary: 日军进攻枣阳、宜昌地区，中国军队顽强抵抗，张自忠殉国，宜昌最终失守。 Japanese forces attacked the Zaoyang and Yichang areas; Chinese troops resisted stubbornly, Zhang Zizhong was killed, and Yichang eventually fell.
fields.description: 1940 年 5 月，日军第十一军向枣阳、襄阳、宜昌地区发动进攻，企图歼灭中国第五战区主力并控制长江上游门户。中国军队在枣阳、襄阳一线抵抗，第 33 集团军总司令张自忠在宜城南瓜店战斗中殉国。6 月，宜昌失守。此役中国军队伤亡重大，但保持了战区主力。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1940, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Zaoyang, Xiangyang, and Yichang areas, seeking to destroy the main forces of China’s Fifth War Zone and control the upper Yangtze gateway. Chinese troops resisted along the Zaoyang–Xiangyang line, and Zhang Zizhong, commander of the 33rd Army Group, was killed in action near Nanguadian in Yicheng. Yichang fell in June. Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties but preserved the bulk of the war zone’s strength. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 百团大战 Hundred Regiments Offensive 百团战役 Hundred Regiments Campaign 正太路破袭战 Zhengding–Taiyuan Railway Sabotage
fields.place: 华北正太铁路沿线（阳泉一带） Along the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway in North China (Yangquan area)
fields.summary: 八路军在华北发动大规模破袭战，打击日军交通线与据点。 The Eighth Route Army launched a large-scale sabotage campaign against Japanese transport lines and strongpoints in North China.
fields.description: 1940 年 8 月 20 日起，八路军在华北发动以破袭正太铁路为重点的大规模进攻，先后参战部队达一百余个团。战役持续至 1941 年初，对日军交通线和据点造成较大打击，也引起日军对华北敌后根据地的更残酷“扫荡”。 本事件日期、地点与规模表述待史料校订。 Beginning on 20 August 1940, the Eighth Route Army launched a large offensive in North China centered on sabotaging the Zhengding–Taiyuan railway, with more than a hundred regiments eventually taking part. The campaign lasted into early 1941, damaging Japanese transport lines and strongpoints and prompting harsher Japanese “mopping-up” operations against base areas. Dates, location, and scale await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军进攻上高，中国军队包围反击，取得上高大捷。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Shanggao; Chinese troops encircled and counterattacked, winning a major victory.

fields.name: 上高会战 Battle of Shanggao 上高大捷 Shanggao Victory
fields.summary: 日军进攻上高，中国军队包围反击，取得上高大捷。 Japanese forces attacked Shanggao; Chinese troops encircled and counterattacked, winning a major victory.
fields.description: 1941 年 3 月，日军第十一军向江西上高地区进攻，企图打击中国第九战区部队。中国军队依托地形逐次抵抗，诱敌深入后实施包围反击，至 4 月上旬收复失地，取得上高会战胜利。此役是抗战中期正面战场的一次重要胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In March 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Shanggao area of Jiangxi, seeking to strike Chinese forces of the Ninth War Zone. Chinese troops resisted in stages using the terrain, drew the Japanese in, then counterattacked and encircled them, recovering the lost ground by early April and winning the Battle of Shanggao. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.summary: 日军围攻中条山中国守军，中国军队遭受重大损失，被迫南渡黄河突围。 Japanese forces besieged Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains; the Chinese army suffered heavy losses and was forced to break out south across the Yellow River.
fields.description: 1941 年 5 月，日军集中兵力围攻山西南部中条山地区的中国军队。中国守军补给困难、指挥协同不足，在日军多路进攻下遭受重大损失，部分部队南渡黄河突围。此役是抗战中期中国正面战场的一次严重失利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1941, Japanese forces concentrated their strength to besiege Chinese troops in the Zhongtiao Mountains of southern Shanxi. Hampered by supply difficulties and poor coordination, the Chinese defenders suffered heavy losses under multiple Japanese attacks, and part of the force broke out south across the Yellow River. It was a serious setback for China’s frontal battlefield in the middle years of the war. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.en: Japanese forces again attacked Changsha; Chinese troops resisted in stages and counterattacked, forcing a Japanese withdrawal to the original line in early October.

fields.name: 第二次长沙会战 Second Battle of Changsha 第二次长沙战役 Second Changsha Campaign
fields.place: 湖南岳阳新墙河一线 Xinqiang River line, Yueyang, Hunan
fields.summary: 日军再次进攻长沙，中国军队逐次抵抗并反击，日军于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。 Japanese forces again attacked Changsha; Chinese troops resisted in stages and counterattacked, forcing a Japanese withdrawal to the original line in early October.
fields.description: 1941 年 9 月，日军第十一军向新墙河、汨罗江一线发起进攻，企图击破中国第九战区主力并攻取长沙。中国军队逐次抵抗，双方在长沙外围激战；日军因补给困难和中国军队侧击，于 10 月上旬退回原阵地。此役双方均有较大伤亡。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In September 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked across the Xinqiang and Miluo rivers, aiming to destroy the main forces of China’s Ninth War Zone and take Changsha. Chinese troops resisted in stages and fought fierce actions on the city’s outskirts. Hampered by supply difficulties and Chinese flank attacks, the Japanese withdrew to their original line in early October. Both sides suffered considerable casualties. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 珍珠港事件 Attack on Pearl Harbor
fields.place: 美国夏威夷珍珠港 Pearl Harbor, Hawaii, United States
fields.summary: 日本海军偷袭珍珠港，太平洋战争爆发，中国抗战与世界大战连为一体。 The Japanese navy attacked Pearl Harbor, starting the Pacific War and linking China’s resistance to the global conflict.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 7 日（夏威夷时间），日本海军袭击美国太平洋舰队基地珍珠港。美国随即对日宣战，太平洋战争爆发。中国战场成为世界反法西斯战争的重要组成部分。 本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期按夏威夷时间标注，待史料校订。 On 7 December 1941 (Hawaii time), the Japanese navy attacked the US Pacific Fleet base at Pearl Harbor. The United States declared war on Japan, and the Pacific War began. The China theater became an important part of the global anti-fascist war. This is an international event with no route drawn; the date follows Hawaii time and awaits historical review.

fields.name: 中国对日宣战 China Declares War on Japan
fields.summary: 太平洋战争爆发后，中国政府正式对日本、德国、意大利宣战。 After the Pacific War began, the Chinese government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 9 日，中国国民政府对日本、德国、意大利正式宣战，并宣布与三国所订一切条约、协定、合同一律废止。中国抗战由此更紧密地融入世界反法西斯同盟。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 9 December 1941, the Chinese National Government formally declared war on Japan, Germany, and Italy and annulled all treaties, agreements, and contracts with them. China’s resistance became more closely integrated into the global anti-fascist alliance. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.summary: 日军第三次进攻长沙，中国军队以“天炉战法”诱敌深入并反击，取得长沙大捷。 Japan attacked Changsha for the third time; Chinese forces drew the Japanese in and counterattacked, winning a major victory.
fields.description: 1941 年 12 月 24 日，日军第十一军再次向长沙进攻。中国第九战区司令长官薛岳采取“天炉战法”，以一部兵力逐次抵抗、诱敌深入，主力从外围侧击、合围。日军攻入长沙外围后补给困难，被迫撤退；中国军队追击，至 1942 年 1 月中旬恢复原阵地。此役是太平洋战争爆发后中国正面战场的一次重要胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 On 24 December 1941, the Japanese 11th Army attacked Changsha again. Xue Yue, commander of China’s Ninth War Zone, employed the “heavenly furnace” tactic: a covering force resisted in stages and drew the Japanese inward while the main force struck the flanks and closed the ring. After reaching the outskirts of Changsha, the Japanese faced supply difficulties and were forced to retreat. Chinese forces pursued and restored the original line by mid-January 1942. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield after the outbreak of the Pacific War. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.description: 1942 年 5 月前后，缅甸战局恶化，中国远征军部分部队经野人山等路线撤往印度，损失惨重；另一部分退回云南。撤至印度的部队后来在兰姆伽整训，整编为中国驻印军。 本事件日期为示意时间点，撤退路线与时间待史料校订。 Around May 1942, as the situation in Burma deteriorated, part of the Chinese Expeditionary Force withdrew to India through difficult routes including the Naga Hills, suffering heavy losses; another part returned to Yunnan. The troops in India were later reorganized and trained at Ramgarh as the Chinese Army in India. The date is an illustrative point; retreat routes and timing await historical review.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked western Hubei; Chinese troops stubbornly defended the Shipai fortress area and thwarted the offensive.

fields.name: 鄂西会战 Battle of West Hubei 石牌保卫战 Defense of Shipai
fields.place: 湖北宜昌石牌 Shipai, Yichang, Hubei
fields.summary: 日军进攻鄂西，中国军队在石牌要塞一带顽强阻击，挫败日军攻势。 Japanese forces attacked western Hubei; Chinese troops stubbornly defended the Shipai fortress area and thwarted the offensive.
fields.description: 1943 年 5 月，日军第十一军向鄂西地区进攻，企图夺取石牌要塞、威胁重庆。中国第六战区部队依托长江三峡地形顽强抵抗，在石牌一带与日军激战，最终迫使日军撤退。此役是抗战后期正面战场的一次重要防御胜利。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked western Hubei, seeking to seize the Shipai fortress and threaten Chongqing. Chinese troops of the Sixth War Zone used the terrain of the Three Gorges to resist stubbornly, fighting fierce actions around Shipai and eventually forcing the Japanese to withdraw. It was an important defensive victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

name.en: Start of the Northern Burma Counteroffensive

summary.zh: 中国驻印军与盟军自印度利多出发，向缅北日军发起反攻。
summary.en: Chinese forces in India and Allied troops advanced from Ledo to counterattack Japanese forces in northern Burma.

fields.name: 缅北反攻开始 Start of the Northern Burma Counteroffensive
fields.summary: 中国驻印军与盟军自印度利多出发，向缅北日军发起反攻。 Chinese forces in India and Allied troops advanced from Ledo to counterattack Japanese forces in northern Burma.
fields.description: 1943 年 10 月起，中国驻印军新一军等部与美军部队自印度利多出发，向缅北推进，先后进行胡康河谷、孟拱河谷等战役，为打通中印公路创造条件。 本事件日期为示意时间点，作战经过待史料校订。 Beginning in October 1943, the Chinese Army in India, including the New 1st Army, and US units advanced from Ledo into northern Burma, fighting in the Hukawng and Mogaung valleys and helping to open the Ledo Road. The date is an illustrative point; operational details await historical review.

summary.zh: 日军进攻常德，中国守军坚守多日后突围，中国军队随后反攻收复常德。
summary.en: Japanese forces attacked Changde; the Chinese garrison held out for days before breaking out, and Chinese troops counterattacked to recover the city.

fields.name: 常德会战 Battle of Changde 常德保卫战 Defense of Changde
fields.summary: 日军进攻常德，中国守军坚守多日后突围，中国军队随后反攻收复常德。 Japanese forces attacked Changde; the Chinese garrison held out for days before breaking out, and Chinese troops counterattacked to recover the city.
fields.description: 1943 年 11 月，日军第十一军向常德地区发起进攻，企图牵制中国军队并夺取洞庭湖周边粮区。中国第 74 军第 57 师坚守常德城，与日军激战多日，伤亡惨重后突围。中国军队外围部队随即反攻，12 月收复常德。此役战斗激烈，双方均有重大伤亡。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In November 1943, the Japanese 11th Army attacked the Changde area, seeking to pin down Chinese forces and seize the rice-producing region around Dongting Lake. The 57th Division of the Chinese 74th Army defended Changde in bitter fighting for many days before breaking out with heavy losses. Chinese forces on the periphery counterattacked and recovered the city in December. Both sides suffered major casualties. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.zh: 中美英三国领导人举行开罗会议，发表《开罗宣言》，明确战后归还中国领土。
summary.en: Leaders of China, the United States, and Britain met in Cairo and issued the Cairo Declaration, affirming the return of Chinese territories after the war.

fields.name: 开罗会议 Cairo Conference
fields.summary: 中美英三国领导人举行开罗会议，发表《开罗宣言》，明确战后归还中国领土。 Leaders of China, the United States, and Britain met in Cairo and issued the Cairo Declaration, affirming the return of Chinese territories after the war.
fields.description: 1943 年 11 月 22 日至 26 日，蒋介石、罗斯福、丘吉尔在开罗举行会议，讨论对日作战与战后安排。会议发表的《开罗宣言》明确表示，日本所窃取于中国的领土，如东北、台湾、澎湖列岛等，应归还中国。 本事件为外交事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 From 22 to 26 November 1943, Chiang Kai-shek, Franklin D. Roosevelt, and Winston Churchill met in Cairo to discuss the war against Japan and postwar arrangements. The Cairo Declaration stated that territories Japan had seized from China, including the Northeast, Taiwan, and the Penghu Islands, should be returned to China. This is a diplomatic event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.name: 豫湘桂战役 Operation Ichi-Go 一号作战 Operation Ichi-Go
fields.summary: 日军发动豫湘桂战役，沿平汉、湘桂铁路南犯，中国正面战场遭受重大损失。 Japan launched Operation Ichi-Go south along the Beijing–Hankou and Hunan–Guangxi railways, inflicting heavy losses on China’s frontal battlefield.
fields.description: 1944 年 4 月 17 日，日军发动豫湘桂战役，先后在河南、湖南、广西等地进攻。中国军队虽顽强抵抗，但郑州、长沙、衡阳、桂林、柳州、南宁等地相继失守，正面战场遭受抗战后期最严重的挫折之一。 本事件日期与范围取通行说法，待史料校订。 On 17 April 1944, Japan launched Operation Ichi-Go, attacking across Henan, Hunan, and Guangxi. Despite stubborn Chinese resistance, Zhengzhou, Changsha, Hengyang, Guilin, Liuzhou, and Nanning fell in succession, one of the most serious setbacks for China’s frontal battlefield in the later war years. Dates and extent follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: The Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and counterattacked toward Tengchong, Longling, and Songshan, recovering western Yunnan by early 1945.

fields.name: 滇西反攻 Western Yunnan Counteroffensive 滇西缅北反攻 Yunnan–Burma Counteroffensive
fields.summary: 中国远征军强渡怒江，反攻腾冲、龙陵、松山，至 1945 年初收复滇西。 The Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and counterattacked toward Tengchong, Longling, and Songshan, recovering western Yunnan by early 1945.
fields.description: 1944 年 5 月，中国远征军强渡怒江，向腾冲、龙陵、松山等地日军发起反攻。中国军队与盟军协同，经过松山、腾冲、龙陵等激战，至 1945 年 1 月收复畹町，打通中印公路。此役是抗战后期中国军队在滇西的重要反攻，与缅北反攻相互配合。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In May 1944, the Chinese Expeditionary Force crossed the Salween and launched a counteroffensive against Japanese forces at Tengchong, Longling, Songshan, and other points. Working with Allied forces, Chinese troops fought fierce battles at Songshan, Tengchong, and Longling, recovered Wanding in January 1945, and opened the Ledo Road. The campaign was an important Chinese counteroffensive in western Yunnan in the later war years, coordinated with the northern Burma offensive. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

fields.summary: 中国远征军围攻松山日军据点，经苦战收复松山，打通滇缅公路关键节点。 The Chinese Expeditionary Force captured the Japanese stronghold at Songshan after bitter fighting, opening a key point on the Burma Road.
fields.description: 1944 年 6 月至 9 月，中国远征军对云南龙陵松山日军据点发起进攻。日军依托坚固工事顽抗，中国军队付出重大伤亡，最终于 9 月 7 日收复松山，为滇西反攻和滇缅公路恢复通车创造条件。 本事件日期、地点与战果待史料校订。 From June to September 1944, the Chinese Expeditionary Force attacked the Japanese stronghold at Songshan in Longling, Yunnan. Japanese troops resisted from fortified positions, and Chinese forces suffered heavy casualties before recapturing Songshan on 7 September, facilitating the western Yunnan counteroffensive and the reopening of the Burma Road. Dates, location, and assessments await historical review.

summary.en: The Chinese 10th Army held Hengyang for 47 days, inflicting heavy losses on Japanese forces before the city fell.

fields.name: 衡阳保卫战 Defense of Hengyang 衡阳会战 Hengyang Campaign
fields.summary: 中国第 10 军坚守衡阳 47 天，重创日军，最终衡阳失守。 The Chinese 10th Army held Hengyang for 47 days, inflicting heavy losses on Japanese forces before the city fell.
fields.description: 1944 年 6 月，日军在豫湘桂战役中进攻衡阳。中国第 10 军约一万七千人坚守衡阳，面对优势日军的围攻，苦战 47 天，伤亡惨重，弹尽援绝，衡阳于 8 月 8 日失守。此役迟滞了日军南进，是抗战后期著名的城市防御战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为城防示意，待史料校订。 In June 1944, Japanese forces attacked Hengyang during Operation Ichi-Go. The Chinese 10th Army, about 17,000 strong, defended the city against a numerically superior Japanese siege for 47 days. With heavy casualties, ammunition exhausted, and no relief in sight, Hengyang fell on 8 August. The defense delayed the Japanese advance south and became one of the best-known urban defense battles of the later war years. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a sketch of the city defense and awaits historical review.

Japan sought to open a continental transport route from North China to Indochina, but overextended lines and dispersed forces made it difficult to hold. This event marks a route segment endpoint; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: Japanese forces attacked the Zhijiang airfield in western Hunan; Chinese troops counterattacked and won the Battle of West Hunan.

fields.name: 湘西会战 Battle of West Hunan 雪峰山会战 Battle of Xuefeng Mountains
fields.summary: 日军进攻湘西芷江机场，中国军队反击，取得湘西会战胜利。 Japanese forces attacked the Zhijiang airfield in western Hunan; Chinese troops counterattacked and won the Battle of West Hunan.
fields.description: 1945 年 4 月，日军发动湘西会战，企图破坏芷江空军基地。中国军队依托雪峰山地形顽强抵抗并反击，至 6 月收复失地，日军伤亡惨重。此役是抗战后期正面战场的一次重要胜利，也是日本投降前中国军队的最后一次大规模攻势防御作战。 本事件日期、地点与战果为通行说法，路线为战役示意，待史料校订。 In April 1945, Japanese forces launched the Battle of West Hunan in an attempt to destroy the Zhijiang air base. Chinese troops used the terrain of the Xuefeng Mountains to resist stubbornly and counterattack, recovering the lost ground by June and inflicting heavy casualties on the Japanese. It was an important victory on China’s frontal battlefield in the final year of the war and one of the Chinese army’s last large-scale defensive-offensive operations before Japan’s surrender. Dates, location, and assessments follow conventional accounts; the route is a campaign sketch and awaits historical review.

summary.zh: 中国军队在广西发起反攻，先后收复桂林、柳州、南宁等地。

fields.name: 桂柳反攻 Guilin–Liuzhou Counteroffensive 广西反攻 Guangxi Counteroffensive
fields.summary: 中国军队在广西发起反攻，先后收复桂林、柳州、南宁等地。 Chinese forces counterattacked in Guangxi, recovering Guilin, Liuzhou, and Nanning.
fields.description: 1945 年 5 月起，中国军队在广西发起局部反攻，逐步收复豫湘桂战役中失守的城镇。随着日本宣布投降，桂柳、南宁等地相继光复。 本事件日期为示意时间点，具体作战进程待史料校订。 From May 1945, Chinese forces launched a limited counteroffensive in Guangxi, gradually recovering towns lost during Operation Ichi-Go. With Japan’s announcement of surrender, Guilin, Liuzhou, Nanning, and other places were recovered. The date is an illustrative point; operational details await historical review.

fields.name: 广岛原子弹爆炸 Atomic Bombing of Hiroshima
fields.summary: 美国在广岛投下原子弹，加速了日本投降的进程。 The United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, accelerating Japan’s surrender.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 6 日，美国在日本广岛投下原子弹，造成大量人员伤亡。8 月 9 日，美国又在长崎投下原子弹。核打击与苏联出兵东北共同加速了日本投降。 本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 6 August 1945, the United States dropped an atomic bomb on Hiroshima, causing massive casualties. On 9 August, another bomb was dropped on Nagasaki. The nuclear strikes, together with the Soviet entry into the war in the Northeast, accelerated Japan’s surrender. This is an international event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

fields.summary: 苏联对日宣战并出兵中国东北，关东军迅速崩溃。 The Soviet Union declared war on Japan and invaded Northeast China, rapidly collapsing the Kwantung Army.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 8 日（莫斯科时间），苏联对日宣战；8 月 9 日，苏军从东、北、西三个方向进入中国东北和朝鲜北部，进攻日本关东军。关东军在短时间内瓦解，日本投降进程明显加快。 本事件为国际事件，不绘制路线；日期按中国通行的 8 月 9 日标注，地点取东北方向示意点，待史料校订。 The Soviet Union declared war on Japan on 8 August 1945 (Moscow time); on 9 August, Soviet forces entered Northeast China and northern Korea from the east, north, and west, attacking the Japanese Kwantung Army. The Kwantung Army collapsed quickly, significantly accelerating Japan’s surrender. This is an international event with no route drawn; the date follows the conventional Chinese usage of 9 August, and the location is an illustrative point in the Northeast pending historical review.

summary.en: The Japanese emperor broadcast the rescript accepting the Potsdam Declaration, bringing victory in China’s war of resistance.

fields.name: 日本宣布无条件投降 Japan Announces Unconditional Surrender
fields.summary: 日本天皇广播《终战诏书》，宣布接受《波茨坦公告》，中国抗日战争取得胜利。 The Japanese emperor broadcast the rescript accepting the Potsdam Declaration, bringing victory in China’s war of resistance.
fields.description: 1945 年 8 月 15 日，日本天皇裕仁通过广播发布《终战诏书》，宣布接受中美英苏四国发表的《波茨坦公告》，实际上宣布无条件投降。中国各地举行庆祝活动，抗日战争取得胜利。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与表述待史料校订。 On 15 August 1945, Emperor Hirohito broadcast the Imperial Rescript on the Termination of the War, accepting the Potsdam Declaration issued by China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union—in effect announcing unconditional surrender. Celebrations took place across China, marking victory in the war of resistance. This is a political event with no route drawn; dates and wording await historical review.

summary.zh: 日本代表在东京湾签署投降书，第二次世界大战正式结束。
summary.en: Japanese representatives signed the instrument of surrender in Tokyo Bay, formally ending the Second World War.

fields.name: 日本签署投降书 Signing of the Japanese Instrument of Surrender
fields.place: 日本东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰 USS Missouri, Tokyo Bay, Japan
fields.summary: 日本代表在东京湾签署投降书，第二次世界大战正式结束。 Japanese representatives signed the instrument of surrender in Tokyo Bay, formally ending the Second World War.
fields.description: 1945 年 9 月 2 日，日本政府代表在东京湾美国“密苏里”号战列舰上签署投降书，中、美、英、苏等同盟国代表签字接受。至此，中国抗日战争与第二次世界大战正式结束。 本事件为政治事件，不绘制路线；日期与地点为通行说法，待史料校订。 On 2 September 1945, Japanese government representatives signed the instrument of surrender aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay, and representatives of the Allied powers, including China, the United States, Britain, and the Soviet Union, accepted it. China’s war of resistance and the Second World War formally ended. This is a political event with no route drawn; date and location follow conventional accounts and await historical review.

summary.en: KMT forces used the Xiang River as a fourth blockade line to encircle the Central Red Army; the Red Army broke through at heavy cost.

fields.description: 1934 年 11 月，国民党军以第四路军（何键部）和桂军（白崇禧部）等依托湘江构筑第四道封锁线，集结重兵堵截中央红军。红军在全州、兴安之间强渡湘江，突破封锁线，但伤亡重大。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In November 1934, KMT forces including the Fourth Route Army (He Jian) and Guangxi forces (Bai Chongxi) established a fourth blockade line along the Xiang River and concentrated troops to intercept the Central Red Army. The Red Army crossed between Quanzhou and Xing’an, breaking the blockade but suffering heavy casualties. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

summary.zh: 中共中央在通道召开紧急会议，讨论红军前进方向。

fields.description: 湘江战役后，中央红军在湖南通道召开会议，采纳毛泽东的建议，改向敌人力量薄弱的贵州前进。 After the Battle of the Xiang River, the Central Red Army met at Tongdao, Hunan, and adopted Mao Zedong’s proposal to move toward Guizhou, where enemy forces were weaker.

summary.en: The Liping meeting decides to advance into central Guizhou, laying the groundwork for the Zunyi meeting.

fields.name: 黎平会议 Liping meeting
fields.summary: 黎平会议决定向贵州腹地进军，为遵义会议奠定基础。 The Liping meeting decides to advance into central Guizhou, laying the groundwork for the Zunyi meeting.
fields.description: 1934 年 12 月 18 日，中共中央政治局在贵州黎平召开会议，决定放弃北上湘西的原定计划，改向贵州腹地进军。 On December 18, 1934, the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee met at Liping, Guizhou, and abandoned the original plan to move north to western Hunan in favor of advancing into central Guizhou.

fields.description: 1935 年 1 月，国民党黔军王家烈部在乌江沿岸设防，企图阻止中央红军北上。红军在江界河等渡口突破防线，打开进军遵义的门户。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In January 1935, KMT Guizhou forces under Wang Jialie set up defenses along the Wu River to block the Central Red Army’s northward advance. atlasTitle.en: The Long March

summary.zh: 确立毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位，是长征的转折点。
summary.en: Establishes Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army; a turning point of the Long March.

fields.name: 遵义会议 Zunyi meeting 遵义政治局扩大会议 Zunyi Politburo Enlarged Meeting
fields.summary: 确立毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位，是长征的转折点。 Establishes Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army; a turning point of the Long March.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 15 日至 17 日，中共中央政治局扩大会议在遵义召开，总结第五次反“围剿”失败和长征初期失利的教训，实际确立了毛泽东在党中央和红军的领导地位。 From January 15 to 17, 1935, an enlarged meeting of the Political Bureau was held at Zunyi. It reviewed the failures of the fifth counter-encirclement campaign and the early Long March, and effectively established Mao Zedong’s leadership in the Party and the Red Army.

fields.summary: 红军在土城与川军激战，随后一渡赤水。 The Red Army fights a fierce battle with Sichuan troops at Tucheng, then crosses the Chishui River for the first time.
fields.description: 1935 年 1 月 28 日，中央红军在贵州习水土城地区与川军郭勋祺部激战，因敌情判断有误未能取胜，随即西渡赤水河。 On January 28, 1935, the Central Red Army fought Guo Xunqi’s Sichuan troops at Tucheng, Xishui, Guizhou. After failing to win because of a misjudgment of enemy strength, it crossed the Chishui River to the west.

fields.summary: 红二十六、二十七军抗击国民党军第二次“围剿”。 The 26th and 27th Red Armies resisted the second KMT encirclement campaign.

summary.zh: 红军由太平渡、二郎滩东渡赤水河，回师黔北。
summary.en: The Red Army crosses the Chishui River eastward at Taipingdu and Erlangtan and returns to northern Guizhou.

fields.name: 二渡赤水 Second crossing of the Chishui River 二渡赤水河 Second Crossing of the Chishui

fields.description: 1935 年 2 月中旬，中央红军在四川古蔺太平渡、二郎滩等地东渡赤水河，回师贵州，攻占娄山关、再占遵义。 In mid-February 1935, the Central Red Army crossed the Chishui River eastward at Taipingdu and Erlangtan in Gulin, Sichuan, returned to Guizhou, captured Loushan Pass, and retook Zunyi.

fields.summary: 红军攻克娄山关，取得长征以来首次大捷。 The Red Army captures Loushan Pass, its first major victory of the Long March.
fields.description: 1935 年 2 月 25 日，红一军团等部攻克娄山关，随后再占遵义，取得长征以来最大的一次胜利。 On February 25, 1935, the First Army Corps and other units captured Loushan Pass and then retook Zunyi, achieving the largest victory since the start of the Long March.

summary.zh: 红军在茅台及其附近西渡赤水河，佯动调动敌军。
summary.en: The Red Army crosses the Chishui River westward at Maotai and nearby, feinting to draw off enemy forces.

fields.summary: 红军在茅台及其附近西渡赤水河，佯动调动敌军。 The Red Army crosses the Chishui River westward at Maotai and nearby, feinting to draw off enemy forces.
fields.description: 1935 年 3 月 16 日至 17 日，中央红军在贵州仁怀茅台镇附近西渡赤水河，作出北渡长江姿态，诱使国民党军西调。 From March 16 to 17, 1935, the Central Red Army crossed the Chishui River westward near Maotai, Renhuai, Guizhou, posing as if to cross the Yangtze and luring Kuomintang forces westward.

fields.summary: 红军秘密东渡赤水河，摆脱敌军围追堵截。 The Red Army secretly crosses the Chishui River eastward and escapes encirclement.
fields.description: 1935 年 3 月 21 日至 22 日，中央红军从二郎滩、太平渡等地秘密东渡赤水河，随后南渡乌江，佯攻贵阳，调出滇军。 From March 21 to 22, 1935, the Central Red Army secretly crossed the Chishui River eastward at Erlangtan, Taipingdu, and other places, then crossed the Wu River southward, feinted toward Guiyang, and drew Yunnan troops out.

summary.en: KMT forces tried to blockade the Jinsha River crossings to stop the Red Army from moving into western Sichuan.

fields.description: 1935 年 5 月，国民党滇军龙云部等追堵中央红军，企图封锁金沙江渡口。红军在皎平渡等渡口巧渡金沙江，摆脱追敌。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In May 1935, KMT Yunnan forces under Long Yun and other units pursued the Central Red Army and tried to blockade the Jinsha River crossings. summary.en: KMT forces blockaded the Red Fourth Front Army, attempting to prevent it from joining the Central Red Army.

fields.description: 1935 年 5 月至 1936 年 10 月，国民党军对红四方面军进行堵截与追击，红军在川陕甘边地区与国民党军周旋，最终北上会宁。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From May 1935 to October 1936, KMT forces blockaded and pursued the Red Fourth Front Army. The Red Army maneuvered in the Sichuan-Shaanxi-Gansu border region and eventually moved north to Huining. Unit designations and command relationships follow conventional accounts and await page-level verification.

fields.description: 1935 年 2 月至 6 月，红二十六军、红二十七军在第二次反“围剿”中先后攻克安定、延长、延川、安塞、保安、靖边等县城，使陕甘边与陕北苏区连成一片。县城名单为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From February to June 1935, the 26th and 27th Red Armies took Anding, Yanchang, Yanchuan, Ansai, Bao’an and Jingbian county seats during the second counter-encirclement campaign, linking the Shaanxi-Gansu border and northern Shaanxi base areas. fields.description: 1935 年 7 月起，国民党军对陕甘苏区发动第三次“围剿”，陕北红军展开反“围剿”作战。9 月红二十五军到达永坪，10 月中央红军到达吴起镇。兵力与起止月份为通行说法，待页码级核对。 From July 1935, KMT forces launched a third encirclement campaign against the Shaanxi-Gansu Soviet area, and the Shaanxi Red Army fought back. fields.description: 1935 年 9 月，国民党新编第 14 师鲁大昌部据守腊子口天险，企图阻止红军北上。红军经过激战夺取腊子口，打开进入甘南的通道。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In September 1935, the KMT New 14th Division under Lu Dachang held the natural stronghold at Lazikou to block the Red Army’s northward advance. After fierce fighting, the Red Army captured the pass and opened the route into southern Gansu. summary.en: The CCP Central Committee decided at Bangluo that the Long March would end in northern Shaanxi.

fields.summary: 中共中央在榜罗镇确定把红军长征落脚点放在陕北。 The CCP Central Committee decided at Bangluo that the Long March would end in northern Shaanxi.

summary.en: After crossing the Liupan Mountains, the Central Red Army defeated a KMT Northeast Army cavalry unit at Qingshizui.

fields.summary: 中央红军翻越六盘山后，在青石嘴击溃国民党东北军骑兵一部。 After crossing the Liupan Mountains, the Central Red Army defeated a KMT Northeast Army cavalry unit at Qingshizui.
fields.description: 1935 年 10 月，中央红军翻越六盘山，在青石嘴击溃国民党东北军骑兵一部，扫清北上障碍。部队番号与指挥关系为通行说法，待页码级核对。 In October 1935, the Central Red Army crossed the Liupan Mountains and defeated a KMT Northeast Army cavalry unit at Qingshizui, clearing an obstacle on its northward route.
